items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch or monetization expansion of the gated product; conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth that preserves consent, disclosures, affiliate disclosures, claims substantiation, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive safeguards. Exact decision: keep the gated product private, keep external outreach unsent, and authorize only bounded read-only evidence work. Concrete blockers are unproven upstream data rights, incomplete privacy and consent evidence, blocked security/accuracy/measurement gates, and missing owner disposition. Human counsel is required for upstream rights and jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment.

Compliance, data quality, site, analytics, and revenue evidence supports containment-only execution. Compliance is a technical baseline, not certification: 37 sites pass, 15 fail, and 7 are unknown, with open banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics is broadly available but has permission errors and yellow freshness/coverage; failed sources remain unknown, not zero. Revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; the aggregate row is not site-attributable, so ROI, margin, and payback remain unsupported. Do not block ordinary growth solely for incomplete telemetry. Parked or unreachable sites require a concrete retain-parked or bounded-launch decision and a completed site-specific checklist before exposure or monetization.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed and 4 remain open. Existing API, terms, support, repository, privacy, and cookie-policy artifacts provide partial evidence only; no task is closable. Open tasks: searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Do not send outreach, enable tracking, expand alerts, change the private gate, or expand monetization.

Data-use review: upstream API deal and price-history data is counsel_required and launch-blocked because access documentation does not establish rights to store, derive, display, cache, retain historical derivatives, send alerts, use trademarks/images/prices, or monetize through affiliate or advertising use. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed pending data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior; next action is a repository and deployed data-flow/retention table. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed pending deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, property/data-sharing settings, retention, and jurisdictional review; next action is read-only configuration capture without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and hosting data are evidence_needed pending log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA review, and incident/request procedures; next action is a read-only operator/vendor inventory.

Private-site decision: retain parked status for complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com. Their scaffold/parked state, missing analytics, and failed or unreachable compliance evidence do not support bounded public launch or monetization. Next evidence action for each site is a timestamped site-specific checklist covering reachability, content, disclosures, compliance, analytics, monetization, and launch decision; do not expose or monetize before completion.

Retain the existing SEO and performance opportunities as deferred backlog only. Their impressions, rankings, CTR targets, sessions, conversions, and performance measurements support prioritization but not revenue, ROI, margin, causal lift, or monetization claims. No new production work, tracking, experiment, dependency, spend, monetization change, or go-live proposal is supported this cycle.
